TOOL MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE

A simpler way to manage tools on the move.

Replace tool-room guesswork and spreadsheet edits with a QR-based record your crew can use in the field.

Start free →

Tool management is a chain of responsibility.

Fieldmark makes that chain visible. Each tool has a QR label, a current location or holder, and a complete history. The next person scanning it sees the record that matters before taking action.

Take

Assign a tool to a worker without a paper sign-out sheet.

Move

Transfer it between a worker, truck, job site, or the shop.

Return

Bring it back with the history intact.

Designed for the job site

Fieldmark runs in a phone browser and uses large, direct actions. Your team does not need another native app, special scanner, or seat-based worker license to make a record.

Make corrections without erasing history

Work moves quickly, and a scan can be wrong. The correction workflow records the fix as a later event, retaining the original action for a reliable audit trail.

The goal is not more data entry. It is a fast, dependable answer to “who has the tool?”
